items.body:
This is a documentation report. The link to AI_POLICY.md on line 9 of [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) points at the `master` branch, which you report returns a 404. The link needs checking against the branch it targets.

On contributing: pull requests are limited to repository collaborators. Describing the change in an issue, as you have done here, is the route for outside contributors. Please read AI_POLICY.md before using AI tools to write a change.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
